trigger: radius_contrast/README.md (post hoc, 2026-10-04): the effective SiC contrast lam2 inverted from the ledger-59 MD falls about 15x from R = 1 to 2 nm. Two forms fit equally: a power law (p = -4.1, registered frame) and a core-shell form. Beyond 2 nm they disagree, and so does the Ge saving at equal kappa_L (x = 0.2, 0.3 um grains, 1 at% C, 300 K): 27-33% if lam2 stops falling, 14-16% at 2.5 nm and 7-8% at 5 nm under the power law. In the ledger-59 design the volume fraction rose with R (phi_eff 1.3%, 4.3%, 10%), so a fall with R cannot be told from a fall with volume fraction.
question: At fixed volume fraction, does the SiC scattering contrast keep falling between R = 2 and 3 nm, and does the fall from 1.5 to 2 nm survive when the volume fraction is held fixed?

method.engine: identical to md_design.json (ledger seq 58): LAMMPS, Tersoff 1989 + inert Ge-C triplets, Muller-Plathe rNEMD, NPT 50 ps, warm 100 ps, production 500 ps, swap every 50 steps, 20 z-bins, x = 0.2, T = 300 K; in.sic_particle, SiCGe_GeC.tersoff and analyze_mp.py are byte-identical copies of ../x03/ (= ../md/)
method.only_change: box size via -var ncxy/ncz, chosen by geometric scaling of the ledger-59 boxes: R = 3.0 nm in 18 x 18 x 60 cells (1.5 x the R = 2.0 nm box, phi_eff 10.1%, as R = 2.0 nm in seq 59); R = 2.0 nm in 16 x 16 x 53 cells (4/3 x the R = 1.5 nm box, phi_eff 4.3%, as R = 1.5 nm in seq 59). The Si-rich pocket stays R + 7 A (not scaled), as in seq 58
method.runs: points.txt: for each of the two boxes, pocket-only control and particle, seeds 20261006 and 20261007; 8 runs. No host runs (registered frame uses the pocket-only control)
method.reference: x = 0.2 runs of ledger seq 59 (../md/results): R = 1.0, 1.5, 2.0 nm in 12 x 12 x 40 cells
method.placement: notchpeak-guest / owner-guest, 64 ranks, requeue; restarts from scratch on preemption (each start logged in results/*.attempts); grn061 and the DGX are not used
method.cost_estimate: seq-59 R = 2 nm run: 46080 sites, about 73 min on 32 ranks. 155520 sites (R = 3 nm) and 108544 sites (R = 2 nm) scale to about 2 h and 1.5 h on 64 ranks if the node is not oversubscribed

gates.G1: as seq 58: Ge-to-centre minus C-to-centre gap >= 5.7 A at start and end of every particle run
gates.G2: every run gives a finite positive kappa
gates.G3: mean C coordination at the end >= 3.3
gates.G4: the two pocket-only seeds in each box agree within 10%

analysis.inversion: analyze_r30.py: each seed-paired reduction r = 1 - kappa(particle)/kappa(pocket-only) is inverted to lam2 with the model side of radius_contrast/fit_radius_contrast.py (Tersoff-scaled almaBTE modes at x = 0.2, 300 K; boundary length matched to the pocket-only control of the same box; phi_eff by the analyze_md.py convention). The same inversion is applied to the seq-59 points
analysis.ratios: ratio_R = lam2(3.0 nm, phi 10%) / lam2(2.0 nm, phi 10%, seq 59); ratio_phi = lam2(2.0 nm, phi 4.3%) / lam2(2.0 nm, phi 10%, seq 59); ratio_Rlo = lam2(2.0 nm, phi 4.3%) / lam2(1.5 nm, phi 4.3%, seq 59); each over the 4 pairings of 2 new and 2 earlier seeds
analysis.threshold: t = sqrt(1.5^-4.1) = 0.435, the log-midpoint between a constant lam2 (ratio 1) and the seq-59 power law (ratio 0.19)
analysis.measured_curve: lam2(R): geometric seed means at R = 1.0, 1.5, 2.0 (seq 59) and 3.0 nm (new), log-log interpolation, beyond 3 nm the 2.0-to-3.0 nm slope (never rising); Ge saving and screening pick recomputed with it through fit_radius_contrast.claims and .pick

predictions.PrR1: branch keeps_falling: every ratio_R < 0.435 (scattering by the disordered interface band, cross-section growing with particle surface, not volume)
predictions.PrR2: every ratio_phi lies in [0.5, 2]: at fixed radius the contrast does not depend on volume fraction within a factor of 2
predictions.PrR3: mean r(R = 3.0 nm) >= 0.05 (the particle still measurably lowers kappa)

decision_rule.stops_falling: every ratio_R >= 0.435: strengthen the about-30% Ge saving; the P1 qualifier 'holds only if the contrast stops falling beyond 2 nm' is replaced by the measured-curve saving at R = 2.5 and 5 nm and the measured-curve screening pick
decision_rule.keeps_falling: every ratio_R < 0.435: correct the P1 Ge-saving claim and the preferred radius to the measured-curve values (saving at 2.5 and 5 nm, screening pick); the 27-33% figure is withdrawn
decision_rule.undecided: the ratios straddle 0.435 or a value is missing: retain the current P1 qualified range (14-33%) and record the ratios
decision_rule.gates_fail: if a gate fails, the failing runs are reported and the decision is taken only if the branch is the same without them; otherwise undecided
decision_rule.phi_note: ratio_phi and ratio_Rlo are reported with the decision; if PrR2 fails, the P1 limitation on volume-fraction dependence is rewritten with the measured ratio, whatever the branch
decision_rule.not_affected: recipe composition (x = 0.3) and carbon content (3 at%) are the same under every radius form tested post hoc; no branch changes them unless the measured-curve pick does, in which case the pick is reported as part of the correct or strengthen operation
